name: Gatewatch the Orange Tabby Cat
blurb: Gatewatch, a big orange tabby with black stripes and copper eyes, walks the garden wall each night and checks that every gate is shut.

name: Murmur the Ginger Tabby Cat
blurb: Murmur, a round ginger tabby with thick black stripes and a pale chin, carries soft whispers between the flower beds and never repeats one.

name: Putter the Marmalade Cat
blurb: Putter, a stocky marmalade tabby with a black-ringed tail and gold eyes, rides in the old garden wheelbarrow and purrs like a small, steady engine.
